title: DNA extraction from environmental biofilm using the NucleoSpin Soil kit
author: Marine Vautier
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bd52i88e

steps.title: Homogenize and pellet biofilm
steps.instruction: Shake the 50 mL Falcon tube containing the biofilm‑ethanol mixture by inverting to obtain a homogeneous solution; pipette 2 mL (1 mL + 1 mL) into a sterile 2 mL microcentrifuge tube, resuspending the pellet between pipettings; centrifuge at 18 000 × g, +4 °C, 30 min; discard supernatant; add 700 µL buffer SL1 (first dissolve any precipitate by incubating the buffer at 30‑40 °C for 10 min and shaking every 2 min); resuspend the pellet and transfer the biofilm/SL1 mixture into a NucleoSpin® Bead Tube Type A.

steps.title: Add enhancer for lysis
steps.instruction: Add 150 µL Enhancer SX to the tube and close the cap.

steps.title: Lyse sample by vortex
steps.instruction: Attach the NucleoSpin® Bead Tubes horizontally to a vortexer (using a special adapter or tape); vortex at full speed at room temperature (18‑25 °C) for 5 min.

steps.title: Precipitate contaminants
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 11 000 × g, (temperature unspecified), 2 min; add 150 µL buffer SL3 and vortex for 5 s; incubate at 4 °C in a fridge for 5 min; centrifuge again at 11 000 × g, (temperature unspecified), 1 min.

steps.title: Filter lysate through inhibitor column
steps.instruction: Place a NucleoSpin® Inhibitor Removal Column (red ring) in a 2 mL collection tube with lid; load up to 650 µL of the clear supernatant onto the column and centrifuge at 11 000 × g, (temperature unspecified), 1 min; repeat loading and centrifugation until all supernatant from step 4 is filtered, collecting the filtered liquid in a single clean tube; discard the inhibitor removal column; if a pellet is visible after centrifugation, transfer the clear supernatant to a new tube (not provided) before continuing.

steps.title: Adjust binding conditions
steps.instruction: Add 250 µL buffer SB, close the lid, vortex for 5 s, then perform a brief centrifugation.

steps.title: Bind DNA to silica column
steps.instruction: Place a NucleoSpin® Soil Column (green ring) in a 2 mL collection tube; load 550 µL of the sample onto the column, centrifuge at 11 000 × g, (temperature unspecified), 1 min, discard the flow‑through and keep the column in the tube; load the remaining sample, centrifuge again at 11 000 × g, 1 min, discard the flow‑through and keep the column.

steps.title: Wash and dry silica membrane
steps.instruction: Using the same collection tube, perform four washes: 1) add 500 µL buffer SB, centrifuge 11 000 × g, 30 s, discard flow‑through; 2) add 550 µL buffer SW1, centrifuge 11 000 × g, 30 s, discard flow‑through; 3) add 650 µL buffer SW2 (verify ethanol was added to SW2 during its first use), centrifuge 11 000 × g, 30 s, discard flow‑through; 4) add another 650 µL buffer SW2, centrifuge 11 000 × g, 30 s, discard flow‑through; finally dry the membrane by centrifuging 11 000 × g, 2 min; if liquid contacts the column after drying, discard the flow‑through and centrifuge again.

steps.title: Elute DNA
steps.instruction: Place the Soil Column into a new microcentrifuge tube (not provided); add 30 µL buffer SE previously heated to 50 °C; do not close the lid and incubate at room temperature for 1 min 30 s; close the lid and centrifuge at 11 000 × g, 30 s; discard the Soil Column and keep the tube containing DNA; store DNA frozen at –20 °C (or –40 °C to –80 °C for long‑term storage) until library preparation.
